recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-37368 unless a future work group decision changes primitive regex policy.
issue_request: FHIR-37368 was a Published FHIR-core datatypes issue resolved Persuasive for R5. It reported mismatches between the primitive datatype regexes shown on the datatypes page and the computable/package representation: integer was missing on the page, uri/url/canonical needed regex exposure in the computable representation, positiveInt was wrong on the page, and markdown differed between page and package with markdown allowed to start with whitespace.
initial_application: Commit 3ef54c37a52ed2d27ea04d457899585052cd4b1f explicitly applied FHIR-37368 by updating source/datatypes.html and source/datatypes/primitives.xml. It added page regex text for integer, url, and canonical, corrected positiveInt to [1-9][0-9]*, preserved \S* for uri/url/canonical in the primitive spreadsheet, and aligned markdown with the computable representation available at that point. Later source cleanup changed the datatypes page to use [%regex ...%] macros, so the rendered page now comes from the same primitive regex source instead of hard-coded literals.
additional_context: The current build-scoped datatype sources are active through source/fhir.ini, including the DataType and PrimitiveType infrastructure entries and the datatypes page. Current source/datatypes/primitives.xml has regex rows for integer ([0]|[-+]?[1-9][0-9]*), uri/url/canonical (\S*), positiveInt ([1-9][0-9]*), and markdown (^[\s\S]+$), while source/datatypes.html references each of those through [%regex ...%] macros. The later Published issue FHIR-40563, already represented on the combined branch, clarified that string and markdown should share the safer ^[\s\S]+$ expression rather than a literal ^.+$, so the current markdown regex is intentional rather than a remaining FHIR-37368 mismatch. FHIR-I WGM minutes record the original 14-0-0 persuasive vote, and no directly relevant Zulip or additional Confluence conflict was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active source already satisfies the FHIR-37368 request, and changing it would either duplicate generated macro behavior or conflict with the later FHIR-40563 clarification for markdown.
